PluginData.Author: yellow51
PluginData.Tooltip: Online multiplayer for Space Engineers 2: dedicated servers, hosting and joining over Steam or IP.
PluginData.Description:
Online multiplayer for Space Engineers 2. Host your world, join friends over Steam or a direct IP address, or play on Y51 SE2 Online dedicated servers listed in the in-game server browser.
Includes chat, a players list, admin tools (kick, ban, whitelist, PvP, PCU limit, sun control, safe zones), factions and grid sharing, a respawn menu and name tags. Everyone in a session needs the same plugin version. Open the Multiplayer screen from the main menu or this plugin's config button.
Network use: checks se2-online.yellow51.dev for updates at game start (can be turned off). Listing a hosted session in the public browser is opt-in and sends your SteamID64, session and world name and player counts to se2-online-sessions.yellow51.dev every 30 s. Joining a server whose world runs Steam Workshop mods you don't have downloads them from Steam, but only after the join shows them with their sizes and you agree (at most 10 GiB per server by default). Workshop mods you already have are updated to the server's version (Steam DownloadItem) without asking and outside that limit. The server browser queries every address the directory lists (Steam server queries, two ports each).
On your PC: on Windows, a low-level keyboard hook runs while you are online or setting a key, so overlays cannot take the plugin's hotkeys. A patch removes the crash handler SE2's AI library (VRage.KytheraV2.Native.dll) installs, which froze the game on every caught exception.
Server owners: unless the server sets a streaming radius, the host sends the whole world state to every joined player, so a modified client could see all of it.
